Subject: Quick technical screen before demo?

Hi Ava,

We just signed up for a trial (Cartflow account: kevin@cartflow.com) and I'm hoping to do a very quick technical triage before scheduling the full product demo. The team wants to make sure Redwood will meet a couple of constraints:

- We need to confirm support for streaming responses with our 1k token use case.
- Data residency — can we point to a US-only endpoint?
- Any guidance about deploying on our GCP project (we use private VPCs).

Would someone from your side be available for a 15-minute call this week to quickly validate those items so we can proceed to the full demo? Ideally tomorrow morning (Feb 19) between 9–11am PST. If that's tight, I can do a short slot on Feb 20 as well.

I attached our signup logs and a screenshot of the error we saw while configuring the API key.

Thanks,
Kevin Li
CTO, Cartflow Inc.
kevin.li@cartflow.com

I have the following 15-minute slots open (all PST):
- Feb 19, 9:30–9:45am
